prompts.title: Recent form
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, approximately 7 seconds, guided by spoken words. Layout: top sixth title 'Forma reciente' in warm white #edf0e6, Spanish labels. Below, two team groups: Inglaterra and Chequia. Chart type: grouped count bars, three bars per team: Victorias, Empates, Derrotas. Shared zero baseline and common scale in partidos. Values resolved as {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} for Inglaterra and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} for Chequia. Axis label 'partidos'. Sample annotation: 'sample: {{home.n}} partidos · source: Bzzoiro' under Inglaterra; 'sample: {{away.n}} partidos · source: Bzzoiro' under Chequia. If samples differ, show Spanish notice 'Muestras desiguales'. Typography: bold condensed sans for title, regular sans for Spanish labels, tabular figures. Entry: bars grow from baseline with staggered timing, lime #c5ed74 for wins, slate #8ca6bf for draws, warm white for losses, on charcoal #101412. Main comparison: Inglaterra vs Chequia. Emphasis: highest bar scales slightly and receives soft glow. Camera: slow vertical push from lower third to center. Transition: crossfade to next graphic. Exit: bars shrink to baseline, title fades. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Keep one focal point: the bar group with the largest count. Labels remain legible. No hardcoded statistics.

prompts.title: Goals for and against
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic sequence, roughly 8 seconds, driven by commentary. Layout: upper half title 'Goles recientes' in warm white, subhead 'A favor y en contra'. Spanish labels. Chart type: paired vertical bars for both teams. Each team has two bars: 'Goles a favor' and 'Goles recibidos'. Shared scale in goles, shared zero baseline. Values: Inglaterra uses {{home.gf}} and {{home.ga}}; Chequia uses {{away.gf}} and {{away.ga}}. Football context: small pitch icon or ball motif in slate #8ca6bf behind bars. Source annotation at bottom of chart: 'source: Bzzoiro · sample: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos'. Use lime #c5ed74 for goals for, slate #8ca6bf for goals against, charcoal #101412 background. Entry: bars rise from baseline, paired by team, labels fade in. Main comparison: goals for vs goals against per team. Emphasis: larger bar in each pair pulses once; gap between paired bars highlighted with thin warm-white bracket. Camera: slight tilt down and push in on the larger gap. Transition: wipe from left to right revealing next frame. Exit: bars retract, labels fade. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Ensure units 'goles' appear on axis and in labels. No hardcoded values.

prompts.title: Clean sheets
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic graphic, about 6 seconds. Layout: centered title 'Arcos en cero' in warm white, Spanish subtitle 'Conteo y muestra'. Chart type: two vertical bars side by side, one for each team. Labels: 'Inglaterra' and 'Chequia'. Values: {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}, unit 'partidos'. Shared zero baseline and common scale. Do not convert counts into rates; show raw counts only. Sample annotation directly under each bar: 'sample: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'sample: {{away.n}} partidos', plus 'source: Bzzoiro'. Colours: lime #c5ed74 for Inglaterra, slate #8ca6bf for Chequia, on charcoal #101412. Entry: bars grow upward, sample labels type on. Main comparison: clean sheet counts. Emphasis: larger count bar gets a soft outline; if both are low, a Spanish caption 'Muestra limitada' appears without inventing values. Camera: static with subtle parallax on labels. Transition: fade through charcoal to next sequence. Exit: bars shrink, title fades. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Typography: bold title, light Spanish labels. Use a thin warm-white axis line. Background remains charcoal with subtle texture. The bars align to a shared baseline at the lower quarter of the chart area. Keep hierarchy clear: title, bars, sample, source. No rate conversion.

prompts.title: Head-to-head history
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 historical comparison, approximately 8 seconds. Layout: title 'Cruces previos' in warm white, Spanish note 'Dato histórico, no es un pronóstico'. Chart type: single stacked horizontal bar representing total sample {{h2h.total}}, split into segments: Inglaterra victorias {{h2h.homeWins}}, Empates {{h2h.draws}}, Chequia victorias {{h2h.awayWins}}. Unit 'partidos'. Shared scale with zero baseline. Spanish labels inside or beside segments. Colours: lime #c5ed74 for Inglaterra, warm white for Empates, slate #8ca6bf for Chequia, on charcoal #101412. Source annotation: 'source: Bzzoiro · sample: {{h2h.total}} cruces'. Entry: bar draws from left to right, segments appear sequentially with counts. Main comparison: historical win/draw distribution. Emphasis: largest segment glows; total sample label pulses. Camera: slow pan along bar. Transition: slide up to reveal synthesis frame. Exit: stacked bar fades to charcoal. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Explicitly state this is historical data, not a forecast, using Spanish text. Use bold condensed numerals for counts, regular sans for Spanish labels. A thin timeline marker shows the sample boundary. The stacked bar occupies the middle half of the frame width, leaving margins for labels. No hardcoded statistics.

prompts.title: Statistical synthesis
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 synthesis sequence, 9–10 seconds. Select compatible historical facts: {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}, {{home.clean}}, {{away.clean}}. Layout: split screen top half Inglaterra, bottom half Chequia, separated by thin warm-white rule. Spanish title 'Tensión estadística'. Chart type: paired dot-and-bar mini charts: for each team, a bar for goals for and a bar for goals against on shared scale in goles; below, a count chip for clean sheets with sample annotation. Values: Inglaterra uses {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{home.clean}}; Chequia uses {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}, {{away.clean}}. Sample: {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} partidos, source: Bzzoiro. Colours: lime #c5ed74 for goals for, slate #8ca6bf for goals against, warm white for clean sheets, charcoal #101412 background. Entry: bars and chips animate in, labels type on in Spanish. Main comparison: attacking output vs defensive vulnerability across both teams. Emphasis: the largest gap between goals for and goals against receives a bracket and Spanish caption 'Contraste'. Published model estimates: none supplied as published=true, so only historical data appears; label all as 'Histórico'. Transition: cross-dissolve from head-to-head. Exit: elements collapse to center, title fades. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. No predictive claims.
